messages:
Alex (eng-infra): kicking off AP-SOUTHEAST-2 edge VPC & account setup for new GPU cluster. Goal: reserve capacity for 4 p4d / 8 H100-equivalent nodes, cross-AZ redundancy, private S3 access, and peering to prod backbone. Need quota checks, CIDR plan, and security controls. tagging & billing to proj-redwood-ap-edge. Who can own the networking bits?

Maria (networking): I can own. First check: AWS service-quotas for ENIs, EBS gp3 throughput, and EC2 GPU instance quotas. Also check if EFA (RDMA) variants are available in ap-southeast-2. I'll open a support case for quota bump. @Cheng can you confirm IAM/KMS boundaries we want on the project?

Cheng (cloud-ops): Confirming IAM: least-privilege roles for cluster-admins + a separate infra-ops role. KMS: create a regional CMK and restrict key policy to proj-redwood-ap-edge principals. Terraform will create kms_alias and grant encrypt/decrypt to redwood-ops role. Quick CIDR proposal: 10.140.0.0/16 for VPC; AZ subnets: 10.140.0.0/18 (az-a), 10.140.64.0/18 (az-b), 10.140.128.0/18 (az-c). Keep /28 per node planning for ENIs. Use dedicated mgmt subnet 10.140.192.0/24 for bastion & monitoring.

Alex (eng-infra): Looks reasonable. I worry /18 might be tight if we scale many pods with host ENIs — maybe /17 per AZ? Let's keep the plan flexible. Also need to decide NAT architecture: NAT gateways per AZ or shared NAT? Cost vs availability tradeoff.

Olivia (eng-runtime): For predictable egress throughput and lower cold-start latency, NAT gateway per AZ preferred. We also want S3 gateway endpoints and ECR VPC endpoints. Can we use prefix lists for S3 instead of NAT for model downloads? That would save egress costs.

Maria (networking): Yes — S3 gateway endpoints are the right call for model artifacts download. But for uploads and third-party repos, NAT will still be used. We'll create S3 gateway endpoint + interface endpoints for STS, ECR, and KMS. Restrictive bucket policies for redwood artifact buckets.

Cheng (cloud-ops): Terraform snippet for VPC + subnet creation (early draft):
```
resource "aws_vpc" "ap_edge" {
  cidr_block = "10.140.0.0/16"
  tags = { Name = "redwood-ap-edge-vpc" }
}
resource "aws_subnet" "az_a" {
  vpc_id = aws_vpc.ap_edge.id
  cidr_block = "10.140.0.0/18"
  availability_zone = "ap-southeast-2a"
}
```
We'll add route tables, endpoints, and NAT attachments in follow-up commits.

OpsBot: proj-redwood-ap-edge created by infra-bootstrapper (account id: 123456789012).

Raj (oncall): Security note — no wide-open SSH. Bastion should be SSM-only (no port 22 open). Also run NACL review; ensure ephemeral ports are limited.

Maria (networking): Agreed. Inbound 0.0.0.0/0 only for ALB on admin plane; management access via SSM Session Manager. Security group plan: cluster-nodes allow intra-VPC traffic on ports 10250, 443; bastion SG allows SSM and HTTPS only.

Alex (eng-infra): GPUs: check instance family availability — H100 availability may be limited. @Cheng can you run: `aws ec2 describe-instance-type-offerings --filters Name=location,Values=ap-southeast-2 --location-type availability-zone` and filter for p4d/p5/h100 offerings and AZ distribution. Also run a quick cost model comparing on-demand vs 6mo reserved capacity.

Cheng (cloud-ops): Running checks now. Preliminary: H100 not available in this region, p4d offered but quota default is 0. Recommend we request quota bump and consider dedicated host reservations for initial capacity commit (6 months) to get lower unit cost. I'll post case number when opened.

Olivia (eng-runtime): For AMI/Runtime: enable ENA + enhanced networking, pre-install NVIDIA drivers, containerd, and a pre-warmed model cache. Baked AMI reduces startup time on scale-up. Also ensure instance role has S3/ECR read-only + kms:Decrypt.

Maria (networking): Handoff validation checklist (what we want green before handoff):
- Quota case opened + target increases (EC2 GPU, ENI limits, EBS IOPS)
- VPC created with agreed CIDR and subnets
- S3 gateway & ECR endpoints deployed
- KMS key and IAM roles provisioned
- NAT gateways per AZ configured
- Route tables and peering to prod backbone validated
- Security groups + SSM-only bastion in place
- Cost estimate doc shared with finance
We'll mark the thread as "ready for handoff" when all items have checkmarks.

Alex (eng-infra): Timeline: target cluster live in ~3 weeks for QBR. Owners: Maria (networking), Cheng (cloud-ops), Olivia (runtime). Raj will perform final security validation/signoff. I'll schedule a 30m handoff meeting next Tue 10:00 PT. @everyone react with :thumbsup: if this plan looks good.

Raj (oncall): :thumbsup: I'll run the pentest checklist after handoff and confirm NACL/SGs.

Cheng (cloud-ops): Quota case opened: AWS-2026-3421. Requested p4d quota=8, increased ENI limits, and EBS baseline throughput adjusted. Will update here once AWS confirms.

Alex (eng-infra): Great, thanks team — will follow up with calendar invite and an initial terraform PR for the VPC in the infra repo.
